# G. Karthik Koundinya

> AI engineer and researcher based in Hyderabad, India. I build agents, retrieval and ML systems that hold up on held-out data, and I research LLM quantization, quantum ML and coding-agent security. Open to applied AI and ML roles.

Headline results (verified 2026-11-25):
- 1st of 4,650 at HackerRank Orchestrate, October 2026 edition (about 50,000 registered), with Ghost Data Still Exists, a data-deletion audit agent.
- 38th of 32,000+ teams, Amazon ML Challenge 2026 (team lead); Amazon invited the team to its Applied Scientist Intern interview.
- Three first-author papers: quantum ML (journal paper, in minor revision), low-bit quantization of Indic language models (RAIT 2027, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, under review) and sensitive-data leakage in LLM coding agents (DAI 2026 AI Paper Track, under revision).
- 79 open-source contributions: 75 merged pull requests across 49 projects with 525K+ combined stars (including PyTorch, Ruff, pandas, mem0, Hindsight, libuv and Sentence Transformers), plus 4 fixes that maintainers landed with credit (Langfuse, PyTensor, PyMC, libunftp).
- Security: listed in the Langfuse Responsible Disclosure Hall of Fame (Jul 2026), and credited as reporter of GHSA-j22j-w4x4-3f6x, a high-severity advisory in Kinto (published 2026-11-23; patched in 26.6.0).
- Experience: AI Engineer Intern at RamanIQ (Aug to Oct 2026), Tech Intern at Hecta Proptech (Jun to Jul 2026) and Full Stack Engineering Intern at chkchk (Jan to Apr 2026).
- Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103) and SQL AI Developer Associate (DP-800), Oracle OCI Generative AI Professional, and 23 certifications in all.
- CodeChef 6★ 2483, LeetCode Guardian 2,720.
